stem: Two irrigation solutions have the same EC but were prepared from different source waters and nutrient recipes. Which conclusion is safest?
choices: Their total conductivity is similar, but their individual ion composition may differ
They must contain identical nutrient concentrations
They will always produce identical root-zone conditions
rationale: Equal EC does not prove identical ionic composition. EC should be interpreted as total conductivity alongside source-water, formulation, and root-zone context.
